items.evidence: The subject is 'One of the meeting rooms', which is singular ('One'). Therefore, the singular verb 'has' is required.
The subject 'The manager and her assistant' is compound connected by 'and', taking a plural verb. The time marker 'now' indicates the present continuous tense ('are').
The time marker 'in 2019' specifies a completed action in the past, requiring the simple past tense ('opened').
The phrase 'since 2021' indicates an action that started in the past and continues into the present, requiring the present perfect tense ('have used').
The time marker 'At the moment' requires the present continuous tense ('are testing').
In a past time clause ('By the time the guests arrived yesterday'), an action completed prior to another past action requires the past perfect tense ('had prepared').
The sentence expresses a regular schedule ('every weekday'), requiring the simple present tense with a third-person singular subject ('The train'), hence 'leaves'.
The time marker 'tomorrow' indicates a future action, requiring the future simple tense ('will review').
Modal verbs ('must') are followed by the base form of the passive voice ('be approved').
The subject ('The damaged items') receives the action of returning, and the time marker 'yesterday' requires the past passive tense ('were returned').
